THE SHUBHAM K MART GUIDELINES19 / 19
19
THE BRAND, CONNECTED

Your AI.
Our brand knowledge.

Connect Shubham K Mart brand tools to your AI assistant. Choose a hosted cloud connection or run the same tools locally, then retrieve colors, fonts, official bag logos and digital design standards.

Your AI tool→SKM MCP→Colors · Fonts · Logos
01 / CLOUD

Connect from anywhere.

Use the Vercel endpoint with an AI tool that supports Streamable HTTP. No local server or Groq key is needed for these brand tools.

https://skmbrandguideline.vercel.app/api/mcp
02 / LOCAL

Keep it on your computer.

Run the same brand tools with Node.js through stdio. Build the downloaded repository first so the full guide and templates are available.

Node.js + mcp-server.mjs
Get the repository ↗
CONNECT IN THREE STEPS

Bring the brand into Codex.

  1. Add the connection.

    Run the cloud command below in a terminal with Codex CLI installed. For local mode, replace the example folder with the absolute path to your checkout.

  2. Check it is available.

    Run codex mcp list. Reload your Codex session if needed so it picks up the new server.

  3. Ask for a real result.

    Ask Codex to call get_brand_colors and show the logo background restrictions. A successful tool response confirms the connection.

Cloud command
codex mcp add skm-brand --url https://skmbrandguideline.vercel.app/api/mcp
Local setup
git clone https://github.com/shubhamkmart/skmbrandguideline.git
cd skmbrandguideline
npm ci
npm run build
codex mcp add skm-brand-local -- node "C:/YOUR-FOLDER/skmbrandguideline/mcp-server.mjs"
Prefer editing the Codex config file?

Add this section to ~/.codex/config.toml (Windows: %USERPROFILE%\.codex\config.toml). Keep existing servers. Use either the command or this config entry.

Cloud TOML config
[mcp_servers.skm-brand]
url = "https://skmbrandguideline.vercel.app/api/mcp"

Setup reference: Official Codex MCP documentation ↗

COPY, PASTE, CONNECT

Let your AI help with setup.

Codex setup prompt
Connect the Shubham K Mart brand MCP to Codex using https://skmbrandguideline.vercel.app/api/mcp. Add it as skm-brand without replacing existing MCP settings. Verify tools/list, call get_brand_colors, and read the yellow logo SVG resource. Report the returned brand colors and logo background restrictions. Never add an API key: this public brand MCP does not need one.
Design task prompt
Use the skm-brand MCP before designing. Retrieve the official colors, typography, bag logo and placement rules. Create a responsive Shubham K Mart website banner using approved assets. Validate the final design with validate_brand_design and report any remaining issues.
One brand library. Two ways to connect.

Both modes expose the same tools, resources and prompts. The cloud endpoint serves public brand information; your AI tool uses its own model. The website chat helper is a separate Groq-powered service. Clients without Streamable HTTP support can use local stdio.

THE PRACTICAL DETAILS

Guidelines in practice

Proposed digital standards
01

Cloud connection

Streamable HTTP endpoint on Vercel. Public brand tools do not require a Groq API key.

02

Local connection

Node.js stdio server from the repository. Build first to generate the full guide and templates.

03

Verify before creating

List available tools, retrieve brand colors and read an official logo resource before starting a design.

04

Use the official assets

Retrieve the supplied SVG or PNG artwork; preserve logo proportions and permitted green/yellow background pairings.
